issues.concern: The English translation 'I think that plan has problems budget-wise' misrepresents the nuance of 無理がある (muri ga aru). While 'problems budget-wise' is not entirely wrong, it loses the sense of 'unreasonable' or 'unfeasible' that 無理がある conveys in this context.
issues.suggestion: I think that plan is unreasonable/unfeasible budget-wise.
